info.name: Visa Application Microservices
info.description:
Runnable contract for the visa application workflow: submission, automated background check, fee payment in TZS and the final decision.

**Run the whole collection in order** — the requests share state through collection variables, so a full run walks one application from PENDING to ACCEPTED and then exercises every guard rail and validation rule.

### Variables

- `baseUrl` — defaults to the frontend's BFF at `http://localhost:3000/api`, which answers from an in-memory simulation of the three services.
- Point `baseUrl` at `http://localhost:8080/api/v1` (or the API gateway) to run the same collection against the real Spring Boot / FastAPI services.
- `applicationId`, `guardApplicationId`, `flaggedApplicationId` and the generated passport numbers are set by test scripts; leave them empty.

### Conventions

JSON is camelCase, timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC, `expireDate` is date-only, amounts are whole Tanzanian Shillings, and every endpoint returns the complete updated application resource.

variable.description: Frontend BFF. Use http://localhost:8080/api/v1 for the Application Service directly.
Randomised per run so the unique constraint never blocks a re-run.
Set by the guard-rail setup request.

Moves the application to BACKGROUND_CLEARED or BACKGROUND_FAILED. The remarks text is shown to the applicant verbatim.

If your implementation screens asynchronously over a broker, return 202 with the application still PENDING and the frontend will poll GET /applications/{id}.
